subject: Horizon Health trial success plan & ownership / acceptance gates
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Thorpe <megan.thorpe@horizonhealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Horizon Health trial success plan & ownership / acceptance gates

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Per our call, here is a short recap and proposed plan to get the trial moving this quarter. I want to make sure success criteria, owners, and weekly checkpoints are explicit so we can finish evaluation in your 4-week window.

Recap (from today's discovery):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for cohort scoring pipeline (latency and cost) and ensure predictions align with current on-prem model.
- Primary success criteria: 1) P95 end-to-end latency < 350ms for < 1k requests/min; 2) Model parity: top-1 accuracy delta <= 2% vs baseline; 3) Token cost per request < target threshold (we agreed to review after run 1).
- Data: You'll provide a 5k-row sample of anonymized events and expected labels for scoring.

Proposed trial plan (high-level):
1) Week 0 (this week): SOW + trial checklist signed, data sample shared. (Owner: Horizon procurement / Raj for data; Chloe for SOW)
2) Week 1: Setup & dry run (ingest sample, test inference endpoint, baseline run). (Owner: Redwood infra / Aditya)
3) Week 2: Scale runs, collect latency/cost metrics, and evaluation against labels. (Owner: Horizon analytics / Raj + Chloe for coordination)
4) Week 3: Review results, adjust batching/quantization suggestions, and final acceptance test. (Owner: Joint)

Action items from call (owners in brackets):
- Horizon: Share anonymized sample CSV + mapping doc by Mon 10/4 (Raj).
- Redwood: Send SOW draft and trial checklist today (Chloe) — attached.
- Redwood infra: Confirm GPU capacity for dedicated test window (Aditya).

Attachments: redwood-trial-checklist.xlsx (trial template), horizon_poc-sow-v1.pdf (SOW stub).

Proposed next meeting: 30 minutes next Wednesday 10/6 to confirm sample arrival and schedule the dry run. Please confirm availability.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

--
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: Megan Thorpe <megan.thorpe@horizonhealth.com>

Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Horizon Health trial success plan & ownership / acceptance gates

Thanks Chloe — solid recap and thanks for the clear owners. A few notes from our side after internal sync: 

- Timeline: We still want to hit a 4-week evaluation window, but procurement needs the SOW + checklist to route approvals. If you can get that today, Raj will try to push data access next week.
- Acceptance nuance: For parity we care mostly about precision@1 for our positive cohort (not overall accuracy) — can we add precision@1 delta <= 2% to the acceptance criteria list?
- Data: We can provide the 5k sample but it will be missing PHI fields — we'll provide a schema mapping and a sample anonymized CSV. Expect to share by 10/4 end of day.

Quick question: do you expect any onboarding scripts or an SDK from our side to call the endpoint, or will you provide a runnable client? We prefer minimal integration on our side.

Appreciate it — Megan

- horizon_poc-sow-v1.pdf (SOW draft)
- redwood-trial-checklist.xlsx (checklist with week-by-week tasks)

Updated success criteria (short):
- Latency: P95 E2E < 350ms under target traffic profile
- Precision@1 for positive cohort: delta <= 2% vs baseline
- Cost: per-request token cost within agreed threshold (will measure after run 1)

Next steps (confirmed):
- Raj: drop anonymized sample CSV + schema mapping by 10/4 (cc when done).
- Chloe: share meeting invite for 10/6 dry run check-in.
- Aditya: confirm infra capacity by 10/5.
